author: Notalgicular
body:
Now, normally anything to do with adverts would be a complete no, annoying and useless.
I think for  the sheer sake of a bit more money going to the server, adverts are a great idea.There is no downside whatsoever.
What it would look like:
It doesn't have to be a big ugly thing that blocks view from any features, and it doesn't have to be anything that would disrupt your browsing in any way shape or form.
It would look something like this:

Is that really to hard to handle? For the sake of a bigger income?


What would we use the money on?
What is arguably the biggest issue with avicus? The lack of development. 
Unfortunately, our two devs are extremely inactive. And quite frankly, we do not have the income to hire a few more devs which we need so much.
Think of personal emails?
You have a question for DoctaPop... email DoctaPop@avicus.net. Question about something? Email StaffEnquiries@avicus.net! Sounds great. Unfortunately, that will never happen. If every sr staff member+plus general staff email had a email, it would cost $130 per month. There are endless posibilities with the extra money from adverts, so I think it is a good idea. Im curious to see others ideas, please do discuss and give feedback
